notes.title: Graphics update for Erazer!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

With this update, we bring updated graphics for Erazer! All the existing official maps, as well as community maps will be getting a sharper look with new appearance for terrain and buildings. Experience the game with updated visuals with the latest patch!

notes.title: New weapons and unlimited budget mode
notes.content:
With this update we introduce the No Budget mode. With this new play mode, you can play any mission in the game without budget restrictions on your loadout. This means you can go in with guns blazing and find new ways to complete the missions.

Additionally we have done some weapons upgrades and rebalancing. Some of the later weapon unlocks are now improved. We also provided updated art for all the weapon variants like silenced pistol and missile launcher!

notes.title: Content and quality update!
notes.content:
Hello all!

With this update, you receive lots of new art and content for the game. Weapons and the game HUD have a new, better look. Additionally we have provided improvements on the gameplay as well as fixed bugs. The level editor now works more smoothly even on larger levels. Enjoy!

notes.title: Catch this!
notes.content:
We have just launched a new map: Catch this!

You have arrived to a remote enemy location with several targets. Armed with just grenades, you need to use your cunning and decisive throws to take down the opposition!

Have fun playing the new map!

notes.title: Improved multiplayer support
notes.content:
Many of you have asked supporting steam networking for better multiplayer connectivity. Now it's finally here! 

Steam support allows connecting with your friends without changing any firewall or other settings. Have fun playing the co-op and pvp modes!

We still support direct p2p connections for eg. performant LAN use.

notes.title: New map: Jungle outpost!
notes.content: This new mission takes you on a remote enemy location deep in the jungle. You are going to need some acrobatics swinging towards the base and taking out guards as you go! Take out the enemy commander inside the base and extract. Good luck!

notes.title: Erazer is launching!
notes.content:
We are glad to announce that Erazer is now out! With the launch, we bring in the campaign view, where you can start your missions on the world map! Additionally we bring in two new missions.

The Shore Fortification is an fortified enemy location with a target inside. Find a way to the bunkered captain and take him out!

The Volcano is the biggest official map up to date. You arrive at a heavily guarded base with several targets and objectives. Fight your way towards the targets and utilize enemy equipment to survive with minimal budget assistance!

notes.title: Launching two new maps!
notes.content:
Kaspar Sky Palace takes you into large enemy location inside a skyscraper. Your objective is to take out the base commander and steal a military item from the basement. Locked areas, large glass windows, drones and a central elevator shaft are the themes of this new mission!

Bozovic's Weapon cargo takes place on a stationary train. Inside you will find security cameras, weapons and a fair bit of resistance. Your mission is to retrieve a weapon from the train vault before it gets into enemy hands!

notes.title: New map: Smuggler's Den!
notes.content: This update introduces a new mission: Smuggler's Den! This remote island is a notorious base of hostiles, bosting tough security and several objectives. You need to retrieve a stolen historical item as well as take out the base commander. Medium and hard difficulties introduce additional targets with tighter loadout budget! Prepare yourself and take on this new mission.

notes.title: New map: Fort Mole!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the launch of a new map: Fort Mole! This map takes on a new mission on an underground enemy base. Your job is to infiltrate the base and take out their commander as well as secure a key item from the vault. Medium and hard difficulties introduce extra targets and challenge.

We also added a bonus mission: Fireworks! You need to finish of a bunch of enemy officers with homing missiles. This mission is sure to improve your guided rocket skills..

notes.title: Two new maps launched!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the launch of two new maps!

The freighter takes place in a container ship overseas. Your mission is to secure an item aboard and escape. Medium & Hard difficulties add an elimination target to the mission.

Stop the Convoy is a classical ambush mission. A large enemy unit is moving between two locations and your mission is to take them out! Use explosives, traps and whatever you need to bring them down!

We also added some graphics improvements in this patch. We added more visuals to hit effects and fixed several bugs. Enjoy the build!

notes.title: Major gameplay and content update!
notes.content:
Hi all!

With this update we introduce several new gameplay mechanics. It's now possible to grab opponents and follow up with several actions:
[list]
[*] Use the grabbed opponent as a shield against bullets
[*] Beat them down or strangle them quietly
[*] Throw them against other enemies to knock them down
[*] Drop them from higher areas to eliminate them
[/list]

We also bring in another new map, The Convict! This map puts you in a tough spot, captured in an enemy base. You need to break out and try not to be seen! If you are spotted, you will face much more resistance.

notes.title: New map: Facility 04!
notes.content:
Build 084 introduces a new map, Facility 04! The facility offers several opportunities of infiltration, but watch out for reinforcements if you are caught. You need to retrieve an item from the high security vault inside, choose your approach and get it!

In the build there are many improvements on overall game quality as well as a new type of enemy resistance, security cameras. Security cameras can call in fresh enemy troops if they spot you. Be on the look out for these devices!

notes.title: Build 083 is now live!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that build 083 is available! We mainly focused on the new loadout builder. All the available weapons and gadgets are now visible which makes it easier to plan and choose your approach. The unlockable items are have a sneak preview as well with the new UI.

As with the previous patches, we bring in various improvements to the game. We have updated the audio, multiplayer and many more features. Have fun with the build!

notes.title: All around improvements with update 81!
notes.content:
With this update we bring improved quality all around the game:
[list]
[*] Much better water behavior and visuals
[*] Improved mission load screen
[*] Better mission selection screen
[*] Explosion traces on maps and background
[*] Showing reviews also for community maps
[*] Improved NPC behavior
[/list]

notes.title: New map: The Monastery
notes.content:
With build 080, we introduce a new official map, The Monastery. The map showcases protect targets, where there are civilians you need to protect or the mission fails. The map takes place on an epic setting with a monastery high on top of a mountain.

Additionally, we bring in new visual effects and improved UI. Community maps are highlighted on the activity feed, and you have direct access to the map download portal from the main menu.

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.content:
-Fixed editor NPC sprites
-Fixed a bug, where level editor did not display player's maps
-Small performance improvements
-Updated lighting on many levels

notes.title: Visual improvements
notes.content:
- Improved visual effects
- Added some new sounds to the game
- Improvements on NPC behaviour

notes.title: New map: The Bunker !
notes.content:
Build 076 is live now! We have added a new map, The Bunker! An end game challenge, you find yourself before a difficult mission without much gear to start with. You need to eliminate an enemy commander and secure a briefcase with vital information. Get ready to challenge yourself with the bunker map!

We added the first version of rag doll physics in the game. This brings satisfying enemy kills in the game with funny situations with rolling bodies.. Enjoy this game enhancing update!

We improved general performance a lot with this update along with visual upgrades. You will see more fluid destruction of terrain, better water physics and more improved with this update. Have fun!

notes.title: PvP Launched!
notes.content:
We are glad to announce that PvP is now out! Battle it out with friends in the provided official maps, or make your own with the editor. It's also possible to play PvP in any existing maps, as well as online maps.

We launched several game tweaking features which are fun to test out with the PvP mode. You can make weapons reload immediately, provide unlimited ammo & gadgets and adjust several other gameplay settings to create any kind of battle you wish! For example, you can make the levels completely dark, so that the players can only see each others via their flashlights..

Budget for each life is completely adjustable, so you can adjust the amount of firepower per player. It's possible to have a tactical battle with limited weaponry or an all-out war with a huge budget. The choice is yours, let the games begin!

notes.title: Game quality update
notes.content: In this patch we bring better quality to several aspects of the game. We looked into lighting quality, animations, particles and the UI to bring better experience for all players. Enjoy the patch!

notes.title: Major graphics & gameplay update
notes.content:
With this update, we provide a large overhaul to gameplay and graphics of the game. We have looked closely into animations, visuals, character movement and dynamic terrain to provide a better experience to the players of the game. This is the first update with the new systems and we will continue to improve on the work we present with this patch.

Earlier in the game, the player always spawned with a sword. Now, on default the player only has fists available, which creates more possibilities for level design and gameplay. The sword is now one of the unlockable weapons, and is provided as one of the first weapons as you proceed in the game.

We added animated arms to all the characters in the game. This allows more fluid movement and animation of the characters. We really like this change, and will continue to improve on the animations and unique movement with different weapons and gadgets.

We have also improved the graphics and effects in the game with this patch. The looks of the game are moving in a good direction and we are able to bring a more alive world with the new effects. This is one aspect we are looking to improve even more in the future, to provide a dynamic world with nice visual effects.

notes.title: Build 069
notes.content:
- Massively improved loading times of maps (up to 80% faster)
- Player can be set to spawn without sword
- NPC route improvements

notes.title: Updated graphics and maps !
notes.content: With this patch, we wanted to focus on new players to the game. The first levels of the game were improved as well as overall improvement to graphics and game UI. It's now also possible to play the co-op mode using a virtual network. This makes connecting to friends easier while using VPN software.

notes.title: Bug fixes and minor tweaks
notes.content:
Regular update with small fixes and improvements
[list]
[*] More natural water resistance
[*] Improvements on functionalities when no internet connection is available
[*] Rain sound is now affected by SFX volume
[*] Syncing explosion sound for multiplayer
[*] Fixed slippery terrain wall sliding
[/list]

notes.title: New map, The Lighthouse !
notes.content:
In this patch, we focused on improving existing official maps, as well as bringing in a completely new map, Kaspar Lighthouse! Featuring many gameplay mechanics in an epic setting, this is our favorite map so far. Additional features and improvement with this patch are:
[list]
[*] Movement related improvements
[*] Visual upgrade to projectile trails
[*] Better lighting
[*] Many improvements and fixes to multiplayer gameplay
[/list]

notes.title: Improved visuals and game core!
notes.content:
Lately, we have developed the game mainly through community suggestions. The last polls saw most votes for multiplayer and game visuals / special effects. We introduced multiplayer co-op in the previous patch and now focused on game visuals and special effects. In this patch you will see
- Better overall graphics
- Nicer animations
- Improved explosion / other effects
- Multiplayer stabilizations

Have fun! Feel free to contact us via our [url=https://discord.gg/YYTB3hGHWp]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Co-op Beta launched!
notes.content:
With the update, we also launched several improvements to the game core. Here's a list of features shipped with this build:
- Co-Op mode (beta)
- Improved character movement and collisions
- Performance updates
- UI improvements
- Interaction improvements
- New sprint animation
- New default look for player

Have fun testing out the new features! You can reach us via discord [url=https://discord.gg/YYTB3hGHWp]here[/url]

notes.title: Launched build 054!
notes.content:
[b]Features and improvements[/b]
- Better NPC pathfinding 
- More looks for NPCs
- Improved interaction with objects
- Enemies now have an indicator for reloading
- UI better for various screen resolutions
- More top times on mission selector
- Enemies with shotgun have smaller firerate making them less punishing 
- Official maps also have rating

[b]Content[/b]
- Tweaks on many official maps
- Changed most official maps lamps to breakable

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Bullets no longer hit undestroyable light bulbs

notes.title: Featuring build 050!
notes.content:
[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] New map: Fields of Kestraria! Featuring team mechanics in the game.
[/list]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Online best times for levels
[*] Activity log for online events
[*] Security cameras added: enemy type that rotates according to the route they are given. Security cameras can also be used as a trigger (just like lever, pressure plates etc.). 
[*] Light sources can be turned on / off with switches
[*] Added a keybinding (default: '1') that can be used to immediatelly equip sword
[*] New vanity items!
[/list]
[b]Improvements & Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Faster loading times for large levels
[*] Fixed issues with player controlled drones
[/list]

notes.title: Released build 047!
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay improvements:[/b]
- Much improved digging while crouching
- Improved melee for NPC characters
- Nicer bullets
- Police and neutral team have their own uniform
- Visual sparks effect for guns while firing
- Better NPC ladder climbing behaviour
- NPCs also notice corpses when alarmed, this will lessen the time NPCs spent looking at corpses after they are not alarmed anymore
- Added a small oxygen cost when starting to sprint. This makes it harder to abuse shift tapping to gain infinite speedboost.

[b]Editor improvements:[/b]
- Moving platforms available! You can use object movers to set their route
- Can now adjust grid in terrain editor
- Keycards can now be set to NPCs in editor. NPCs drop them upon death. 
- Reinforcement points and turrets can now be set to triggers
- Any character can be set as a protect objective. Their death will result in failure of a mission

notes.title: Build 045 out!
notes.content:
Hi, we just rolled out build 045! Thank you for all the feedback on the game.
- Copy/Paster for items in editor (ctrl + c) to copy selected item. (ctrl + v) to paste the copied item
- NPCs now run to the spot where they were shot from when they are hit by a bullet
- NPCs in police team also get aggressive when stabbing someone within their vision
- Better performance on many enemies shooting at the same time
- Now taking damage while swimming on lava surface
- Fixed a crash that could occur during loading screen
- Stun grenade, dirt bomb and pressure grenade no longer start fires
- Small improvements to npc ladder choosing
- Bug fixes: Turret should no longer damage itself in cases where it is shooting downwards
- Fixed some npc routes in Wester Wastes Bunker and Baneville Airport
- Setting explosives to "isArmed" in editor no longer causes problems
- Equipped armor is now also visible in editor
- Blocking draw while mouse is over panels in editor
- Can now undo both fill tool and erase in editor
- Running sounds for player
- Improved main menu and loadout builder
